title: Tag Duel
description: Local tag duels (2 vs 2) and handicap duels (1 vs 2, 2 vs 1) with solo life points, from the Tag Duel menu button.

settings.title: Deck mode
settings.help: Tag duels: separate = each partner has their own hand and deck (the engine swaps them in at each turn change); shared = partners play one hand and deck.

settings.title: Partner deck
settings.help: A .ydc deck for your tag partner (relative paths are from the game folder). Empty = a copy of your own deck.

settings.title: Opponent partner deck
settings.help: A .ydc deck for the opponent's tag partner. Empty = a copy of the opponent's deck.
